title: SG-5.4 · Admin route tests prove every admin endpoint rejects missing and wrong tokens
summary: Unit tests with mocked dependencies show that every admin round and execution endpoint, including retry and approve, rejects missing and wrong tokens.
description: Context: server.New mounts /api/v1/admin behind admin.Middleware(cfg.Admin.Token). TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken in backend/internal/server/server_test.go covers only the five round endpoints and only the missing-token case; GET /executions, POST /executions/{id}/retry and POST /executions/{id}/approve and the wrong-token case are untested. Desired behavior: one route table feeds both registration and the tests, so no admin endpoint can be added unprotected or untested. Expected result: missing and wrong tokens give 401 on all 8 admin endpoints. Why: admin APIs must be protected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a server with admin.token 'tok', when any of the 8 admin endpoints is called without an Authorization header, then the response is 401.
Given the same server, when any of the 8 admin endpoints is called with 'Authorization: Bearer wrong', then the response is 401.
Given the same server, when POST /executions/{id}/retry and POST /executions/{id}/approve carry 'Bearer tok', then the response is not 401.
Given the admin route table, when the chi router is walked, then every registered /api/v1/admin route appears in the table.

in_scope: Server-level auth unit tests for round and execution endpoints
preserve: Existing admin route paths and handlers

technical_constraints: Tests use httptest with temp dir repo, no network
definition_of_done: All acceptance criteria asserted by passing unit tests
